title: get_health_check_status
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/ returns 200 with a string indicating the health status when the service is healthy.

title: post_auth_register_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid email and password returns 201 with TokenResponse containing access and refresh tokens.

title: post_auth_login_with_valid_credentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid user credentials returns 200 with TokenResponse containing access and refresh tokens.

title: post_auth_refresh_with_valid_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/refresh with a valid refresh token returns 200 with new TokenResponse containing new access and refresh tokens.

title: post_auth_logout_with_valid_access_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/logout with a valid Authorization Bearer access token returns 200 with no content.

title: get_users_me_with_valid_access_token
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/users/me with a valid Authorization Bearer access token returns 200 with the current User profile.

title: post_podcasts_create_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/podcasts with valid Authorization Bearer access token and valid podcast data returns 201 with the created Podcast object.

title: post_episodes_create_with_valid_data_and_audio
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/episodes with valid Authorization Bearer access token and valid episode data including audio file returns 201 with the created Episode and triggers push notifications to followers.

title: post_creators_become_with_valid_data
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/creators/become with valid Authorization Bearer access token and valid creator data returns 201 with the created Creator profile.

title: post_follows_creators_creatorid_with_valid_access_token
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/follows/creators/:creatorId with valid Authorization Bearer access token returns 201 with Follow object indicating the user is now following the creator.
